amount_off.description: The fixed amount off in the smallest currency unit, such as cents, when not using a percentage discount.

currency.description: The three-letter ISO currency code for a fixed-amount discount.

duration.description: How long the discount applies: 'once', 'repeating', or 'forever'.

duration_in_months.description: The number of months the discount repeats for when duration is 'repeating'.

name.description: The name of the coupon displayed to customers on invoices.

percent_off.description: The percentage discount the coupon applies.
